title: Run outcome
description: The body of the signed POST to <run.url>/<run_id>/outcome, application/json, with which the run's starter says how the run ended. It is signed by any active key of the node or node pool that registered the run, under qory-request-ed25519-v1, sent directly or through a gateway's relay. The outcome sets the run's state whenever it arrives while the run's record is kept, before or after dev.qory.run.exited; the exit code, the signal and Forager's reason stay on record beside it. Each run gets one outcome: the same one repeated is accepted, and a different one is a signed 409 outcome_given. With no state, the outcome is cancelled with the reason stopped. The answer is a signed 200 whose body is run-outcome-answer.schema.json. A server refuses a time outside 300 seconds of its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses a version it does not read.

state.description: How the run ended, dev.qory.run.exited's vocabulary. Absent, the outcome is cancelled with the reason stopped.

reason.description: The starter's reason: a code, a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and underscores, up to 64. A reason that is no code, or that is one of Forager's reserved codes, is dropped, and the outcome is kept. Forager's client sends a reason only with a state.

time.description: When the starter gave the outcome, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. A server refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.
